suggestion: Functional description too short: expand it into a natural-language paragraph covering triggers, processing, outputs, and error handling so a reader understands the core functionality and business value (at least 10 characters; target at most 500).
Functional description exceeds the limit: condense it into one readable paragraph (500 characters by default), keeping only the core functionality and business value.
Invalid funcId format: copy it verbatim from the upstream plan function (uppercase alphanumeric segments joined by '-', at least two segments of 1-8 characters each, e.g. USR-FAV-01).
Invalid functional user role format: start with a lowercase letter and use only lowercase letters, digits, and hyphens, e.g. customer or user-management-system.
Business rule description too short: state the rule and its enforced effect (at least 10 characters), e.g. "account locks for 30 minutes after 3 failed logins".
